ops.desc: estructuras visibles con selector y lista

ops.code: () => { const v=document.querySelector('product-list'); if(!v||v.offsetParent===null) return false; const its=Array.from(v.querySelectorAll('ion-item')).filter(i=>!/No hay/i.test(i.textContent)); return its.length>0 && /C\u00f3digo/i.test(v.textContent) && /Precio/i.test(v.textContent); }

() => { const its=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('product-list ion-item')).filter(i=>!/No hay/i.test(i.textContent)); return its.length>0 && its.length<50 && its.every(i=>/COSTILLA/i.test(i.textContent)); }

() => { const v=document.querySelector('product-list'); const its=Array.from(v.querySelectorAll('ion-item')).filter(i=>!/No hay/i.test(i.textContent)); return its.length===0 && /No hay productos disponibles/i.test(v.textContent); }

ops.desc: detalle con nombre, codigo, precio y unidad
ops.code: () => { const v=document.querySelector('product-detail'); if(!v||v.offsetParent===null) return false; const t=v.textContent.replace(/\s+/g,' '); return /C\u00f3digo/i.test(t) && /Precio/i.test(t) && /Unidad/i.test(t) && t.length>40; }

() => { const v=document.querySelector('product-detail'); const s=v.querySelector('ion-select'); const opt=Array.from(s.querySelectorAll('ion-select-option')).find(o=>o.textContent.trim()==='Precio 2'); if(!opt) return false; s.value=opt.value; s.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('ionChange',{bubbles:true,detail:{value:opt.value}})); s.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('ionInput',{bubbles:true,detail:{value:opt.value}})); const p=document.querySelector('ion-popover'); if(p&&p.dismiss)p.dismiss(); return true; }
